name: unpackerr
description: RAR download extractor for Sonarr, Radarr and Lidarr! Mount /downloads on all 3 or 4 containers to the same path on your host. This application will automatically poll all of the apps (Lidarr, Sonarr, Radarr) to check for downloads. When a completed download contains a rar file, this application will extract the file and move the extracted contents back into the download location. Files will be extracted recursively in an attempt to get all subtitles. If you don't use one of Lidarr, Sonarr or Radarr, simply empty those two fields for that app and it wont be polled. If you put all your containers on the same custom bridge you may not need to expose any ports, and you can use DNS to reach other containers. It's a very convenient configuration!

paths.name: Downloads Location
paths.description: Container Path: /downloads - this must be the same path on this app and sonarr/radarr/lidarr!

variables.name: Debug Log Output
variables.description: UN_DEBUG - Turns on more logs. You should use this at least once so you know what it does.

variables.name: Log File Path
variables.description: UN_LOG_FILE - Logs will be written to this path if provided. Recommended, but required.

variables.name: Sonarr API Key
variables.description: UN_SONARR_0_API_KEY - API Key - leave blank if not using Sonarr

variables.name: Sonarr Download Path
variables.description: UN_SONARR_0_PATH - Path to find Sonarr downloads. Must be within /downloads location (above)

variables.name: Radarr API Key
variables.description: UN_RADARR_0_API_KEY - API Key - leave blank if not using Radarr

variables.name: Radarr Download Path
variables.description: UN_RADARR_0_PATH - Path to find Radarr downloads. Must be within /downloads location (above)

variables.name: Lidarr API Key
variables.description: UN_LIDARR_0_API_KEY - API Key - leave blank if not using Lidarr

variables.name: Global Timeout
variables.description: UN_TIMEOUT - How long to wait for the apps to respond to API requests. Recommend 10-15s

variables.name: Parallel Extractions
variables.description: UN_PARALLEL - Most setups will not benefit from more than 1. Recommend 1

variables.name: Polling Interval
variables.description: UN_INTERVAL - How often to talk to Sonarr, Radarr and Lidarr. Recommend 1-4m

variables.name: Delete Delay
variables.description: UN_DELETE_DELAY - How long to wait before deleting extracted files. Recommend 5-30m

variables.name: Start Delay
variables.description: UN_START_DELAY - How long to wait before extracting completed downloads. Recommend 1m for local and 5m+ for remote

variables.name: Retry Delay
variables.description: UN_RETRY_DELAY - How long to wait before retrying failed extractions. Recommend 5m
